verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials for agents is a fair question for a note-taking app with cloud services like Sync and Publish, so the axis applies. The pack never documents scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent tokens. Headless Sync for agents, Restricted Mode, and selective sync are related features but are not credential scoping, and community notes say plugins have full system access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
